prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location review concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Chunky hard square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained three-tone stone timber linen iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painting or photorealism. No people, no readable text, no quest UI, no magic, no claimed outcome. Modest practical scale, no giant fantasy architecture. Open ordinary return path clearly visible. Geometry is a proposal, not certified collision or inventory. Small private stone courtyard hearth beside wine-market back lane. One clearly EMPTY chair with ONE old plain wine cup on a small side ledge, not a tomb or altar. Separate ordinary dining bench and plain bread bowl at another small table; ordinary route to market remains open and does not pass through the empty chair. Cold modest hearth, sparse ivy on weathered stone and terracotta roof. No grave, skull, apparition, portrait, confirmed death or returned person, no mandatory ritual, no money or sale concluded. Focus remembrance and everyday eating as separate voluntary uses.
